label: Bible Study
prompt: For other _____ can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
verse: For other foundation can no man lay than that is laid, which is Jesus Christ.
note: Paul the master builder says there's only one foundation worth laying.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be _____ with my goodness, saith the LORD.
verse: And I will satiate the soul of the priests with fatness, and my people shall be satisfied with my goodness, saith the LORD.
note: God promises His people will be satisfied with His goodness — a full table after the exile.

label: Sunday School
prompt: As newborn babes, desire the sincere _____ of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
verse: As newborn babes, desire the sincere milk of the word, that ye may grow thereby:
note: Peter's picture of spiritual growth: crave the word the way newborn babies crave milk.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was _____ in those days; there was no open vision.
verse: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.
note: In Eli's day God rarely spoke — which is why young Samuel didn't recognize the voice calling him at night.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your _____.
verse: And Moses spake unto Aaron, Say unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, Come near before the LORD: for he hath heard your murmurings.
note: Israel grumbled for bread, and God heard every one of their 'murmurings' — then answered with manna anyway.
